task.description:
Design and add test coverage for SCH-01 durable timer creation.

Requirements for test design/output:
- Create or update tests/specs/SCH-01.md with explicit traceability to SCH-01 acceptance criteria.
- Add unit/integration tests that verify:
  1) timer record persistence on timer-node arrival,
  2) atomic persistence with transition/state write semantics,
  3) restart durability expectations for PENDING timers,
  4) immediate-due behavior for fire_at <= NOW,
  5) cancelled-instance rejection path.
- Ensure tests are deterministic and do not rely on uncontrolled wall-clock timing.
- Keep tests aligned with current architecture and run targets.

Validation:
- Ensure zig test targets compile and pass for newly added tests.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/SCH-01.md exists and maps each SCH-01 AC to test cases
Automated tests cover all required SCH-01 behaviors
Test artifacts are ready for TEST-RUNNER execution

result.summary: Created SCH-01 test spec and integration tests for durable timer creation, covering timer persistence on timer-node arrival, atomic transition/state write semantics with timer persistence, restart durability for pending timers, immediate-due fire_at <= NOW behavior, and cancelled-instance rejection path.

issues.description: Full integration suite did not fully pass due pre-existing environment/state issues outside SCH-01 scope (PgError.AuthenticationFailed in TC-DB-02-04 and existing duplicate-name collisions in snapshot/EE-09/EE-10 integration tests).
